notes.title: Wacky VR sim Traffic Jams is out now [10% OFF]
notes.notes:
[b]In this wacky VR game, control traffic your way in the face of outrageous events and flagrant road rage. Easy? Think again! Traffic Jams throws in monsters, (un)natural disasters, and up to 4 non-VR friends in party mode![/b]

[url=https://youtu.be/trETkh4nBnI][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738013/a0924461e784c0bb89011cdc53a32ffc64edab1a.jpg[/img][/url]

Starting out on a quiet corner in a small town, job offers start pouring in from around the globe. Guide rude pedestrians, impatient drivers, and the occasional meteorite along before road rage strikes. Sound easy? Think again! This wacky VR game is full of monsters, (un)natural disasters, and something called… ‘cheese bowling’?

Made it to the top in career mode? Keep your VR headset cool as up to 4 non-VR friends turn up the heat in (couch) party mode!

[b]Save 10% on Traffic Jams until 14 April 2021[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301930/Traffic_Jams?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=announcement&utm_campaign=launch][h1][BUY NOW][/h1][/url]

Traffic Jams is developed by Little Chicken Game Company (REKT!, Track Labs) and published by Vertigo Games.

See you on the battlegrounds!

notes.notes:

Hey all,

We're helping our friends over at indie VR studio Innerspace bring their mind-bending VR puzzle adventure [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/559330/A_Fishermans_Tale]A Fisherman's Tale[/url] to VR headsets later this year! 

Check out the announce trailer below:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G1JC-DdZ5RY
In A Fisherman's Tale, being turned upside down and inside out is not merely a play on words. Playing as Bob, a fisherman's puppet, you'll have to break more than a couple of laws of physics to solve the surreal VR puzzles on your path!

notes.title: Perils of Man update and Polish version
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce Polish interface and subtitles have been added to Perils of Man for Windows and Mac!

We have also improved the following game-play elements: 

- Hot spots are easier to identify and to click on. 
- Risk objects are easier to identify with the Risk Atlas. 
- Inventory items that are obsolete will automatically be removed from the inventory. 
- Save game system has been revamped to be more stable.
- Many other stability and convenient fixes.

notes.title: Polish version added for Windows and Mac
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce Polish interface and subtitles have been added to Perils of Man! You can select the Polish language under Perils of Man Properties > Languages in your Steam Library or in-game under settings. 

We also felt like Perils of Man has been a struggle for some players. Ex: inaccurate Hot Spots and Risk Object detection. Therefore, we have improved the following game elements: 

- Hot spots are easier to identify and to click on. 
- Risk objects are easier to identify with the Risk Atlas. 
- Inventory items that are obsolete will automatically be removed from the inventory. 
- Save game system has been revamped to be more stable. 
- Other stability and convenient fixes.

notes.title: Game update
notes.notes:
- Dialog options will now be displayed with subtitles set off.
- Item interactions and descriptions will now be displayed with subtitles set off.
- Localization fix for cinematics: will now play the right subtitles and/or audio depending on your settings.
- Resolved an issue where items got stuck in the inventory.

Have fun!

notes.title: Time Tiller: The Perils Of Man
notes.notes:
I loved Bill Tiller’s work as an artist at Lucasarts, where he worked on several games including Full Throttle and Outlaws, as well as acting as art director on The Dig. That’s a healthy CV. Post-Lucasarts, Tiller has written and worked as project lead on two adventure games since then that I don’t have any attachment to – A Vampyre Story and Ghost Pirates of Vooju Island – but I like what I’ve seen of The Perils of Man, a tablet game designed by Tiller and due to arrive on Steam on April 28th. It’s a tale of time travel, historical catastrophes and family. The trailer is below.
